data.name: Mugheera
data.gender_notes: Mugheera is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who guides and shows the way. The name Mugheera carries the meaning “Guide, Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mugheera usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies guidance and illumination, both spiritually and in life's challenges
data.etymology: Mugheera belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mugheera total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

They are seen as individuals who have the ability to navigate complex situations and provide guidance to those who may be lost.

The name is often associated with the concept of guidance from Allah. Muslims believe that Allah guides and protects them throughout their lives, and the name Mugheera serves as a reminder of this divine guidance. It is also believed that individuals named Mugheera have a special role in helping to guide and instruct others in their faith and in their lives. The name is a source of inspiration and motivation for those who bear it to serve as a beacon of light and guidance for others.
